newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaraguan inflation rises 0.79 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Nicaraguan inflation rises 0.79 pct in May.

text.p: Nicaragua's consumer price index rose 0.79 percent in May, up from the 0.4 percent rise in April but down from the 1.73 percent registered in May 1996, the Central Bank reported on Thursday.
Accumulated inflation was 1.11 percent through May compared with 5.27 percent for the first five months of 1996, the Central Bank said.

The monthly price of basic consumer goods for a family of six was $147.90 in May, down from $149.15 in April, the Central Bank said. The list of items of basic consumer goods is different from and less inclusive than the overall index of consumer prices that determines inflation.
